name: vscode-ifc-viewer
description: Open and explore IFC (.ifc) building models in a real 3D viewer inside VS Code: orbit, spatial tree, selection, properties and psets. Pairs with AI agents such as Claude Code to highlight elements by GlobalId.

ifcViewer.agentBridge.enabled.markdownDescription: Show the **Connect to agent** button and allow connecting an AI agent (for example Claude Code with IFC Skills). Nothing is written until you connect a folder; connecting writes `.ifc-skills/viewer/` in it. Turning this off stops every connection.

enumDescriptions: Every session starts disconnected; use the button or the Connect to Agent command.
Reconnect the folders you connected last time, and only those.
Connect a folder as soon as an IFC file in it opens.
ifcViewer.agentBridge.autoConnect.description: When the viewer connects to an agent on its own.

ifcViewer.agentBridge.heartbeatSeconds.markdownDescription: How often `state.json` is refreshed (its `heartbeatAt`) and the inbox is re-scanned, in seconds.

ifcViewer.agentBridge.selectionDebounceM.markdownDescription: Minimum time between `state.json` writes for selection and highlight changes, in milliseconds. The first change is written at once.

ifcViewer.agentBridge.maxCommandAgeSecon.markdownDescription: Commands whose `createdAt` is older than this are rejected, in seconds.

ifcViewer.agentBridge.maxIdsPerCommand.description: Largest number of GlobalIds one command may carry.

ifcViewer.agentBridge.commandTimeoutSeco.description: How long a command may wait for a model to load or the viewer to answer before it fails, in seconds.

ifcViewer.agentBridge.outboxRetentionMin.markdownDescription: Answers in `outbox/` older than this are deleted, in minutes.

ifcViewer.agentBridge.removeFolderOnDisc.markdownDescription: Delete `.ifc-skills/viewer/` when you disconnect (and `.ifc-skills/` when connecting created it and it is left empty). When off, `state.json` stays with `open: false`.

ifcViewer.agentBridge.revealHiddenCatego.description: Show spaces or openings when an agent selects, highlights or isolates them (they are hidden by default).

enumDescriptions: Reload models in folders connected to an agent.
Reload every open model when its file changes.
ifcViewer.autoReload.mode.description: Reload an open model when its .ifc file changes on disk.

ifcViewer.autoReload.debounceMs.description: Wait this long after the last file change before reloading, in milliseconds.

ifcViewer.autoReload.stabilityCheckMs.description: Reload only once two file checks this far apart see the same size and time, in milliseconds.

ifcViewer.autoReload.keepView.description: Keep the camera, selection and agent highlights across a reload.

ifcViewer.highlightLegend.visible.description: Show the legend of highlight groups (with clear buttons) while any group exists.

scripts.test:ext: npm run build && npm run compile:test && node ./out-test/test/runTest.js
scripts.test:ext:packaged: npm run build && npm run compile:test && node ./out-test/test/runTestPackaged.js
